cookies.name: sidebar_state
cookies.purpose: Remember whether the optional desktop sidebar UI primitive is expanded or collapsed.
cookies.deletion: Expires after seven days or is overwritten when the sidebar preference changes.

nonCookieState.name: cart-state
nonCookieState.mechanism: React client state or explicitly reviewed local browser storage
nonCookieState.purpose: Keep cart continuity client-side without creating a first-party identity or checkout cookie.

externalCookieProviders.purpose: Hosted payment and fraud-prevention flow after the customer leaves the storefront origin.

prohibited: customer, order, vendor, sourcing, margin, payment, or webhook data in cookies
using sidebar_state for authorization, pricing, cart, checkout, or analytics
tracking or advertising cookies without a separately approved consent system
forwarding Set-Cookie headers from the static asset binding
